title: Current Political Truth & Temporal Resolution Architecture Specification
governance: CTO Master Implementation Architecture Freeze Directive

steps.role: Sovereign state/UT envelope (e.g. TS, UP, AS)
Delimitation boundary version active at date D
Specific electoral event in that seat (e.g. 2023 General Election)
Winning candidate record with immutable election party
Sovereign term starting on gazette notification date
Check if seat vacated before date D
If vacated, traverse to subsequent by-election winning tenure
Check contemporaneous party switches valid at date D
Resolved sovereign representative + contemporaneous party at date D

officeholderVsPartySeparation.officeholderFact: Elected tenure belongs to the HUMAN PERSON. Officeholder status remains valid until end of term, resignation, disqualification, or death.
officeholderVsPartySeparation.partyFact: Political party affiliation is a temporal relationship. Changing party during a tenure creates a tenure_party_switch record, updating contemporaneous party without modifying the immutable election party or historical contest.

vacancyModel.stateBehavior: When asOfDate >= vacancy.effective_date (and before by-election winner takes oath), API returns status: "VACANT", representative: null, vacancy_details: {...}

chainStructure: New Winning Tenure (starts on by-election gazette date)

partySwitchModel.immutabilityRule: candidacies.party_id is FROZEN and NEVER updated after election certification.
partySwitchModel.temporalResolutionLogic:
SELECT coalesce(tps.to_party_id, et.original_party_id) AS contemporaneous_party
      FROM public.elected_tenures et
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT to_party_id
        FROM public.tenure_party_switches
        WHERE tenure_id = et.id AND effective_date <= asOfDate
        ORDER BY effective_date DESC, created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) tps ON true
      WHERE et.id = :tenureId;

affidavitRightsTaxonomy.principles: Do not claim broad "Sovereign Public Domain" without official legal counsel. Classify all political facts under structured technical data rights taxonomy.

classifications.description: Mandatory statutory candidate declaration filed under RP Act 1950 Sec 33A / Form 26.
Unprocessed string or numeric values directly scraped or parsed from Form 26.
Parsed and typed fields (e.g. integer INR assets, date parsed DOB, enum education).
Net worth calculations, asset growth percent, criminal severity scoring.
Editorial biography paragraphs, party commentary, news digests.
External opinion, political ratings, editorial evaluations.
Data where provenance does not cleanly map to official ECI Form 26.
